source: MAFF / Boosting Food Production Program (PMO), Royal Government of Cambodia — ខ្សែសង្វាក់ផលិតកម្ម ដំណាំស្វាយចន្ទីនៅកម្ពុជា (Cashew Value Chain Study in Cambodia), field survey report (250 household respondents across major cashew-growing provinces), 2017, 57pp
text:
Cashew cultivation calendar and variety comparison, from farmer-survey results in the 2017 MAFF cashew value chain study (n=250 households).

Based on the surveyed farmers' cropping calendar, first fertilizer application typically falls around October-December, flowering occurs mainly around December-January, and harvest runs mainly January through June, consistent with the well-known Cambodian cashew season pattern (flowering in the cool/early dry season, harvest concentrated in the dry season).

Variety survey results: of 250 respondent households, 51% (127 households) grew the improved M23 variety, 45% (112 households) grew traditional local Khmer cashew varieties, and small numbers grew M09 or M21 varieties (about 1% each) or other varieties (about 3%).

Key varietal difference noted by farmers: local Khmer cashew has a thicker shell and smaller kernel, while the M23 variety has a thinner shell and larger kernel — the larger, more valuable M23 kernel is the main reason farmers have been switching to it despite (per the pest/disease findings below) it being more vulnerable to pest damage than the traditional local variety.

New-variety propagation risk: because M23 has become popular, farmers sometimes obtain seedlings or grafting material that is mislabeled or not true to variety; farmers who invest years in growing out a tree only to find it is not genuine M23 lose significant time and money, since cashew trees take several years to reach productive bearing age.
caveat: Some specific figures in this source (percentages, price points, yield ranges) were transcribed from a scanned document at a resolution where certain digits were hard to confirm with full pixel-level certainty. Figures are reported as best-effort readings of the source; anyone using exact numbers for decisions should verify against the original report where possible.
